🔥 stealth-browser-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable AI agents and automated scripts to interact with websites that employ sophisticated anti-bot measures, such as Cloudflare, by providing an undetectable browser automation solution.
✨ Key Features: • Bypasses anti-bot systems and Cloudflare challenges • AI-driven network hook generation • Pixel-perfect UI cloning via chat commands • Utilizes nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol
📖 Summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for advanced browser automation, specifically engineered to bypass anti-bot systems and CAPTCHAs. It leverages AI to automate network requests and replicate user interfaces with high fidelity, enabling seamless web scraping and interaction with protected websites.
